newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme Carticel revenue over $1 mln in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme Carticel revenue over $1 mln in Q4.

text.p: Genzyme's Tissue Repair Division said it generated more than $1 million in fourth- quarter revenue from its Carticel service, which stimulates growth in a patient's own cartilage cells to repair knee damage.
A company spokeswoman would not comment on what the revenue would mean to the company's fourth-quarter earnings. The company will release its fourth-quarter earnings on March 6, she said.

The company also said it performed 101 implant procedures in the fourth quarter using Carticel, up from 44 in the corresponding quarter in 1995. The company has trained 1,500 orthopedic surgeons to date in treating patients with Carticel, it added.
Genzyme Tissue develops biological products for the treatment of cartilage damage, severe burns, chronic skin ulcers and neurodegenerative diseases, it said.
